description: This file implements the source code for a plugin called OCDM within the WPEFramework, handling initialization, deinitialization, memory observation, and processing HTTP requests related to Open Content Decryption Module (OCDM). It defines classes, functions, and interfaces for managing OCDM systems, including memory monitoring and system querying functions.

classes.name: MemoryObserverImpl
classes.description: A class implementing the Exchange::IMemory interface to observe memory usage related to a remote connection, wrapping Core::ProcessInfo and providing methods Resident, Allocated, Shared, and Processes.

methods.name: MemoryObserver
methods.description: A function that creates and returns an instance of MemoryObserverImpl to observe memory for a given remote connection.
